models.provenance_limit: Model tags are mutable; these names do not establish immutable model-digest reproducibility.

metadata.title: Synthetic Invoice Copies and Fields FAQ

source.scope_rule: Only this approved source/version/content with public access scope may support automatic FAQ replies. Public is customer-facing inside the fictional local demo, not approval for real customer use.

facts.quote: Only workspace owners and billing admins can download issued invoices for a workspace they are authorized to access.
Regular workspace members cannot download invoices.
To download an issued invoice, sign in, open Billing > Invoices, select the invoice, and choose Download PDF.
This FAQ documents PDF downloads only; it does not specify CSV export or automatic emailing.
An invoice number identifies the invoice document; it is not an account number or proof that payment has been completed.
The billing period is the date range covered by the invoice's charges; it is not the payment-due date.
The currency field identifies the denomination of the invoice amounts; it does not provide an exchange rate.
This local copilot can explain these FAQs. It does not retrieve or send private invoices, grant permissions, change billing details, cancel subscriptions, or process refunds.

case_sets.change_policy: Source assumptions, fact definitions, rubric, and expected cases are frozen for this version. Changes require a new contract/source/case version as applicable, with explicit review; do not overwrite gold to fit model outcomes.
case_sets.canonical_hash_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')); JSONL hashes use the ordered array of parsed cases. Source content uses its exact UTF-8 string.
case_sets.isolation_rule: Use development cases only for prompt/settings tuning: baseline plus at most two targeted variants. Run the final candidate once on heldout, do not tune against those results, and report a no-go or a separately approved next experiment if it fails.
case_sets.coverage_limit: These are authored synthetic cases, not representative production traffic or a statistical error-rate estimate. Heldout includes unseen field-number questions and cross-family/multi-field compositions.
case_sets.legacy_corpus_rule: Preserve Week 3 and assessor gold/heldout files. Adding invoice-copy knowledge changes answerability; do not compare old missing-evidence controls against an expanded live corpus as if corpus versions were unchanged.

case_label_semantics.required_fact_ids: Minimum complete semantic answers for eligible cases, not literal phrases to match. Every requested distinction and case condition must also be preserved.
case_label_semantics.permitted_fact_ids: Relevant approved facts allowed in a substantive reply. An ID or real quote does not establish that the generated statement follows from it.
case_label_semantics.negative_cases: A safe clarification, abstention, or review outcome need not emit substantive FAQ facts. Any partial factual answer must still use permitted evidence and preserve conditions.
case_label_semantics.forbidden_claims: Semantic prohibitions, not a blacklist of exact strings.
case_label_semantics.initial_runtime_handling: Generated responses are pending review during development/evaluation, including eligible positives. Candidate eligibility is recorded separately from actual handling.

after_promotion_handling.auto_eligible: The request fits approved families and has no unsupported parts. No-review additionally requires a valid complete final reply, all runtime checks, promotion gates, and explicit learner enablement.
after_promotion_handling.human_review: Mandatory review; an answerable FAQ fragment never authorizes an action, private-data access, or a financial/security request.
after_promotion_handling.clarify_or_abstain: The request is ambiguous or unavailable from approved guidance. Clarify or explicitly abstain; retain review in this pilot.

semantic_rubric.pass: Every factual statement follows from the approved source and is relevant. Correct citations or assessor status alone are insufficient.
semantic_rubric.verification: Manual semantic review of the captured reply and cited passages; record unsupported/incorrect claims.

semantic_rubric.pass: All requested parts and required facts/distinctions are addressed. A negative case explicitly identifies unknown or unsupported parts instead of pretending they were answered.
semantic_rubric.verification: Manual per-request-part review, using required fact IDs as references rather than word-presence checks.

semantic_rubric.pass: Required roles, authorized workspace, issued-invoice restriction, field distinctions, and limitations are preserved wherever relevant.
semantic_rubric.verification: Manual semantic review plus tested narrow runtime guards where they can be implemented reliably.

semantic_rubric.pass: No invented feature availability, private values, deadlines, permission grants, completed actions, payment verification, or financial promises.
semantic_rubric.verification: Manual semantic review and boundary/failure regressions; phrase matching is not a complete safeguard.

semantic_rubric.pass: Factual claims are attributed to approved retrieved passages that actually support them. Source identity/version/scope, chunk identity, and exact quotes are valid.
semantic_rubric.verification: Deterministic provenance/reference checks plus manual claim-to-citation entailment review.

semantic_rubric.pass: Candidate routing matches the contract, actual review-first handling remains intact before promotion, and malformed/truncated/provider-failed outcomes are explicit failures rather than quality passes.
semantic_rubric.verification: Recorded mode, candidate decision, review reasons/state, completion metadata, errors, and saved-state tests.

measurement_rules.same_response: Score retrieval, factual grounding, citations, semantic rubric, handling, and latency on the same captured API outcome; do not issue separate calls for separate quality metrics.
measurement_rules.retrieval_fact_recall_at_k: Required fact quotes present in approved retrieved chunks divided by required fact quotes for scored eligible cases; record k. Also report source-level recall separately so one correct document ID cannot hide missing passages.
measurement_rules.groundedness: Semantically supported factual claims divided by all factual claims in generated replies. No factual claims, preview-only outcomes, and errors are unscored, not automatic passes.
measurement_rules.citation_correctness: Factual claims with valid attribution to supporting approved passages divided by all factual claims requiring evidence; missing citations are not excluded from the denominator.
measurement_rules.semantic_review: Review every generated development/heldout reply for this small pilot. Record per-case findings and coverage; this release evaluation is not a requirement for humans to review every future eligible request.
measurement_rules.routing: Report unsafe false accepts, conservative false rejects, expected-positive eligibility recall, actual reviewed/automatic/clarified/abstained/failed counts, and denominators.
measurement_rules.confidence: Unknown remains null. Neither cosine distance nor a model/heuristic score is an authorization signal.

latency.report: Warm and combined percentiles, cold separately, cold/warm mix, generated versus fallback case mix, hardware/power state, token counts, client wall and component times.
latency.miss_policy: No-go unless the learner explicitly approves a documented target/scope change.

promotion_gates.no_go_behavior: Keep useful generated replies review-first, record the blocker and bounded next decision, and do not claim completed automation.
